import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv')

# Check the unique habitat types
unique_habitats = df['habitat'].unique()
print("Unique habitat types:", unique_habitats)

# Create a contingency table of 'n.gard' by 'habitat'
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(index=df['habitat'], columns=df['n.gard'])

# Perform a chi-squared test to determine if there is a significant association between 'n.gard' and 'habitat'
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)

# Display the contingency table and the chi-squared test results
contingency_table, chi2, p, dof
